description: This file defines the AzureBlobStorageOptions class and its associated validator in the Orleans.Storage.AzureStorage namespace. It provides configuration options for Azure Blob Storage integration, including setting up the BlobServiceClient, container name, creation of container factories, and validation logic.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for Azure Blob Storage as used in Orleans storage providers. Manages BlobServiceClient setup, container name, storage serializer, and lifecycle stage.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates AzureBlobStorageOptions configuration, ensuring required properties like credentials and container names are valid.

methods.name: ConfigureBlobServiceClient
methods.description: Multiple overloaded methods to configure the BlobServiceClient with different authentication approaches, marked obsolete in favor of setting the BlobServiceClient property directly.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks validity of the stored AzureBlobStorageOptions instance, specifically verifying credentials and container/blob names.
